<div class="review-text">
The Hunger Games managed to take off in my cultural domain's collective consciousness a while ago which got me very excited about the idea of a battle royal for all of the wrong reasons. When I was fascinated with the hunger games, I wasn't considering it in terms of a dystopia <a class="review-spoiler-link" href="https://www.goodreads.com/review/show/2563261431">(view spoiler)</a>, but as a really cool and fun violence-fueled arena. <a class="review-spoiler-link" href="https://www.goodreads.com/review/show/2563261431">(view spoiler)</a> Overall, the Hunger Games is written ineffectively and isn't able to provide a substantial plot or themes. It is permeated by poor writing <a class="review-spoiler-link" href="https://www.goodreads.com/review/show/2563261431">(view spoiler)</a> which is best passed up for other books.
